title: ACP alternative path: 3-D Secure step-up
summary: The merchant requires 3DS, sets authentication_required, and rejects a complete call without authentication_result. The agent runs Delegate Authentication and completes again.

steps.label: Session status authentication_required
steps.detail: The merchant must include authentication_metadata (acquirer details, directory server).

steps.label: Complete without authentication_result
steps.detail: A client error that the spec handles explicitly.

steps.label: 4XX requires_3ds
steps.detail: Error with type invalid_request, code requires_3ds and param $.authentication_result.

steps.label: POST /delegate_authentication
steps.detail: Create an authentication session for the merchant, card and amount. Status action_required, pending or not_supported.

steps.label: Fingerprint, then POST .../authenticate
steps.detail: The client loads the 3DS method URL, waits up to 10 seconds and reports fingerprint_completion Y, N or U.

failures.outcome: The buyer completes the issuer challenge

steps.label: Issuer challenge (if any)
steps.detail: The buyer proves identity to the issuer.

steps.label: Complete with authentication_result
steps.detail: The client must send the outcome even when it is denied.

failures.outcome: Merchant declines; session stays open or ends per merchant policy
